sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meetings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), "row_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (row_revision >= 0), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ((is_deleted = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (is_deleted = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= 0), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_duration_us" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lifecycle" TEXT NOT NULL, "language_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "trashed_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "lifecycle_before_trash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (media_duration_us >= 0), CHECK (lifecycle IN ('draft','preparing','recording','pausedByUser','pausedByInterruption','stopping','finalized','recoverable','failedFinalization','trashed','deleting')), CHECK (language_mode IN ('chinese','english','mixed')), CHECK ((lifecycle IN ('trashed','deleting')) = (trashed_at_utc_ms IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (lifecycle_before_trash IS NULL OR lifecycle_before_trash IN ('draft','preparing','recording','pausedByUser','pausedByInterruption','stopping','finalized','recoverable','failedFinalization')), CHECK ((lifecycle IN ('trashed','deleting')) = (lifecycle_before_trash IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((lifecycle IN ('trashed','deleting')) = is_deleted), CHECK ((trashed_at_utc_ms IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR trashed_at_utc_ms = deleted_at)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audio_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), "row_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (row_revision >= 0), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ((is_deleted = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (is_deleted = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= 0), "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_start_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_duration_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "committed_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sequence >= 0), CHECK (media_start_us >= 0), CHECK (media_duration_us >= 0), CHECK (committed_bytes >= 0), CHECK (state IN ('open','committed','corrupt','missing')), CHECK (length(relative_path) > 0), CHECK (relative_path NOT LIKE '/%'), CHECK (instr(relative_path, char(92)) = 0), CHECK (instr(relative_path, char(0)) = 0), CHECK (relative_path NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z]:*'), CHECK (('/' || relative_path || '/') NOT LIKE '%//%'), CHECK (('/' || relative_path || '/') NOT LIKE '%/../%'), CHECK (('/' || relative_path || '/') NOT LIKE '%/./%')) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recovery_findings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), "row_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (row_revision >= 0), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ((is_deleted = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (is_deleted = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= 0), "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "segment_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (segment_sequence IS NULL OR segment_sequence >= 0), CHECK (code IN ('recording_recovery_timeline_gap','recording_recovery_segment_missing','recording_recovery_segment_corrupt','recording_recovery_tail_discarded'))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), "row_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (row_revision >= 0), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ((is_deleted = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (is_deleted = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= 0), "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "wall_clock_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "monotonic_elapsed_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_offset_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sequence >= 0), CHECK (wall_clock_utc_ms >= 0), CHECK (monotonic_elapsed_us >= 0), CHECK (media_offset_us >= 0), CHECK (type IN ('started','pausedByUser','resumedByUser','interrupted','stopped','recovered'))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), "row_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (row_revision >= 0), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ((is_deleted = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (is_deleted = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= 0), "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "media_offset_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (media_offset_us >= 0), CHECK (kind IN ('bookmark','highlight'))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "model_manifests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), "row_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (row_revision >= 0), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ((is_deleted = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (is_deleted = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= 0), "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_engine_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "license_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "license_snapshot_path" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (bytes >= 0), CHECK (length(sha256) > 0), CHECK (length(license_snapshot_path) > 0), CHECK (license_snapshot_path NOT LIKE '/%'), CHECK (instr(license_snapshot_path, char(92)) = 0), CHECK (instr(license_snapshot_path, char(0)) = 0), CHECK (license_snapshot_path NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z]:*'), CHECK (('/' || license_snapshot_path || '/') NOT LIKE '%//%'), CHECK (('/' || license_snapshot_path || '/') NOT LIKE '%/../%'), CHECK (('/' || license_snapshot_path || '/') NOT LIKE '%/./%')) STRICT;
